pilot.note: Stopped pilot is retained separately; interruption is not a model failure.

adaptive.followup_author: Primary Codex agent responds to actual observed tutor replies under predeclared scenario states.
adaptive.failure_handling: Retained second-turn application guard failure; no retry substituted and no follow-up fabricated after the episode closed.

concurrency: Adaptive cohort may overlap the fixed-case run on the same resident server, whose max-running-requests is2. This is a quality study, not an isolated latency benchmark; request overlap can affect timings and sampling. Neither cohort changes runtime settings.
review: One Codex reviewer applies PedAdvisor and AI Tutor lenses. No independent human review or NotebookLM consultation; that capability is unavailable.

adaptive_input_pilot.note: Initial noninteractive stdin closed after the first reply. Restarted all adaptive cases with TTY stdin; interrupted input-channel pilot is retained separately, not scored as a model failure.
